title: Herbal Crunchy Indian Seafood Salad
description: A fresh, herbal salad that blends a quick bhuna-tossed frozen seafood mix with crisp veggies and roasted chickpeas, finished with a lowfat yogurtlemon dressing.
instructions: Thaw the frozen seafood in a bowl of cold water for 10 minutes, then pat dry.
Heat the ghee in a non‑stick skillet over medium heat.
Add garam masala, cumin, coriander, and turmeric, sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the seafood, stir and cook for 2–3 minutes until just opaque; do not overcook.
Transfer the seafood to a bowl and let it cool to room temperature.
Meanwhile, toss diced cucumber, red bell pepper, and chopped herbs in a separate bowl.
Add roasted chickpeas to the veggie mixture.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, lemon juice, and mustard powder until smooth; season with salt and pepper to taste.
Combine the cooled seafood with the veggie and chickpea mix; gently fold in the dressing.
Toss lightly to coat everything evenly.
Garnish with a sprinkle of fresh cilantro if desired and serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to eat.
